geography: Worldwide net sales of Aldurazyme: the BioMarin/Genzyme LLC joint venture's revenue (2003-2007), Genzyme's product revenue line (2008-2010), Genzyme's net sales as reported by BioMarin (2011-2012), Sanofi's worldwide net sales line (2013 on)
moa: Recombinant human alpha-L-iduronidase enzyme replacement therapy

launch_evidence.quote: Our first product, Aldurazyme, was approved by the FDA for commercial sale in the United States on April 30, 2003, and has only generated nominal sales revenue to date.

series_start_reason: Series starts at the 2003Q2 launch (FDA approval 30 April 2003). The joint venture's Q1 2003 revenue (334 USD thousands, printed as the prior-year column of BioMarin's Q1 2004 Form 10-Q) was pre-approval and is not carried.
notes: One scope throughout: worldwide net sales of Aldurazyme. Until 31 December 2007 all Aldurazyme sales were recorded by BioMarin/Genzyme LLC, a 50/50 joint venture accounted for by equity method; BioMarin's Forms 10-Q and 10-K print the joint venture's results table ('Revenue', from 2007 'Net product sales'). From 1 January 2008 Genzyme records the net product sales (Genzyme Forms 10-Q and analyst schedules). For 2011-2012, after Genzyme stopped filing and before Sanofi printed Aldurazyme on its own line (from Q1 2013), the quarters are BioMarin's 'Aldurazyme revenue reported by Genzyme' line; that line equals Genzyme's own figures where both exist (BioMarin FY 2010 166.8 = Genzyme 39,897+43,651+40,766+42,466 USD thousands). BioMarin's own 'Aldurazyme' net product revenue (royalty and product transfer revenue) is a different measure and is not used. Currencies: USD for 2003Q2-2012Q4 (thousands for the joint venture and Genzyme rows, millions for the 2011-2012 rows), EUR for Sanofi from 2013Q1; values not converted.
search_log: BioMarin Pharmaceutical Inc. (CIK 1048477): EDGAR full-text search restricted to CIK 1048477 for 'Aldurazyme' (410 hits); the 112 Form 10-Q and 10-K HTML documents among them were fetched and parsed. Joint-venture results table rows ('Revenue' / 'Net product sales', prior-year column first) read for 2003Q2-2007Q3; fourth quarters 2003-2007 are the joint venture's annual revenue in the Form 10-K less the nine-month figure of the Q3 Form 10-Q (2003: 11,540-4,884; 2004: 42,583-26,968; 2005: 76,417-55,201; 2006: 96,291-69,891; 2007: 123,671-88,270). BioMarin's narrative confirms the figures (e.g. 'Aldurazyme net revenue recorded by our joint venture during the first quarter of 2005 totaled $15.9 million').

Genzyme Corporation (CIK 732485): Forms 10-Q 2008Q1-2010Q3 'Aldurazyme' product revenue row; fourth quarters from the analyst schedules (2009Q4 in the 2010-02-17 release, 2010Q4 in the 2011-02-16 release; 2008Q4 from the Q4-08 column of the 2009-04-22 schedule because the February 2009 release has no Aldurazyme row; it equals the 2008 Form 10-K annual 151,321 less nine months 113,742).

BioMarin 'Aldurazyme revenue reported by Genzyme' rows: Forms 10-Q 2011Q1-2012Q3 (current column first); 2011Q4 = 185.2 - 136.4 and 2012Q4 = 193.1 - 140.0 (Form 10-K annual less Q3 Form 10-Q nine months).

Sanofi (CIK 1121404): Aldurazyme has its own row in every quarterly results release from Q1 2013 (2013-05-02) to Q2 2026; the 2011 and 2012 releases print no Aldurazyme row (Genzyme table limited to Cerezyme, Myozyme/Lumizyme and Fabrazyme). Same release list and method as sanofi_lumizyme.
